entries.name: Aunt Ping
entries.title: Your aunt
lines: Eat something before you run off.
Your mother had the same stubborn chin.
The river gives, the river takes. Mostly it gives fish.
barks: Who left the net out again?

entries.name: Lu
entries.title: Ferryman
lines: The river has been restless.
Breathe in when the water rises. Out when it falls.
Every current started as a trickle.

entries.name: Little Dou
entries.title: Neighbour's boy
lines: When I grow up I'll punch a crab so hard it flies to Stoneford!
Did you see my kite? It's the best kite.

entries.name: Old Ma
entries.title: Shopkeeper
lines: Silver or barter, I'm not fussy.
Rice balls! Fresh this morning. Well. This week.

entries.name: Granny Liu
entries.title: Herbalist
lines: Bitter tea, sweet health.
A herb picked at dawn is worth two at noon.
barks: Where did I put my pestle?

entries.name: Shen Lian
entries.title: Fisher's son
lines: Race you to the tower. Loser guts the fish.
One day I'll join a sect. A real one.

entries.name: Uncle Guo
entries.title: Retired brawler
lines: Fists first. Everything else is decoration.
I kindled Qi once. For a day. Long story.

entries.name: Fisher Wen
entries.title: Fisherman
lines: The carp aren't biting. Something scared them.
Grey water near the reeds last week. Never seen that.

entries.name: Washer Mei
entries.title: Villager
lines: Aunt Ping says you're finally awake before noon.
The river's cold as winter this morning.

entries.name: Captain Hou
entries.title: Gate guard
lines: Stoneford gate. Keep your blades sheathed.
Recruitment Fair's on the Fairground. West, past Artisan Row.

entries.name: Foreman Dong
entries.title: Quarry foreman
lines: Stonewall Quarry needs strong backs.
Rock beetles again. Curl up, roll, bite. Watch the curl.

entries.name: Kai
entries.title: Wandering swordsman
lines: The Caravan Road's gone bad. Bandits call themselves the Mudwater.
I came for the tournament. I stayed for the tea.

entries.name: Proprietor Fang
entries.title: General store
lines: Teas, rice, charms. If Stoneford needs it, Fang sells it.
Return charms! Never walk home again!

entries.name: Auntie Rong
entries.title: Tea house
lines: Lotus root tea calms the belly and the Qi.
Sit. Everyone who sits in my tea house leaves stronger.

entries.name: Keeper Shi
entries.title: Stone keeper
lines: Teleport stones remember those who touch them.
A shard of Spirit Stone pays the ferryman of the stones.

entries.name: Courier Lin
entries.title: Courier
lines: Letters to every sect, parcels to every village.
The mail finds you. Somehow. Always.

entries.name: Su Qing
entries.title: Herb hunter
lines: The bamboo grove east of the marsh has ember peppers. And vipers.
Never eat a mushroom that smiles at you.

entries.name: Old Pan
entries.title: Wandering merchant
lines: Rare wares for rare coin. Spirit Stones only.
I'm here today. Tomorrow? Who knows.

entries.name: Smith Bao
entries.title: Blacksmith
lines: Iron remembers every hammer blow.
Bring me Jadeiron and I'll make you something that sings.

entries.name: Tinkerer Yu
entries.title: Tinkerer
lines: Tools are just patience you can hold.
A better pickaxe means more ore and fewer blisters.

entries.name: Elder Gu
entries.title: Trade house master
lines: Everything has a price. Most things have two.
Bring me curiosities and I'll tell you what they're worth.

entries.name: Madam Hua
entries.title: Trade house master
lines: The trade house deals fairly now. I promise you that.
Gu's ledgers made interesting reading.

entries.name: Mei Qing
entries.title: Alchemist
lines: A pill is a promise. Keep it simple and it keeps you alive.
Willow moss, riverreed ginseng, and patience.

entries.name: Mei Qing
entries.title: Visiting alchemist
lines: I teach at both sects. The furnace doesn't care about robes.

entries.name: Apprentice Tao
entries.title: Smith's apprentice
lines: Master Bao says I'll hold a hammer next year.
Did you know iron can taste angry?

entries.name: Qing Lan
entries.title: Jade Sect recruiter
lines: The Jade Sect teaches the water's patience and the sword's clarity.
Our academy sits by the river. You'll feel at home.

entries.name: Mo Yun
entries.title: Cloud Sect recruiter
lines: The Cloud Sect climbs. Our monastery touches the clouds.
Wind cannot be held. Neither can a Cloud disciple.

entries.name: Shen Lian
entries.title: Cloud Sect disciple
lines: We picked different sects. Doesn't mean I'll go easy on you.
Spar me at the practice yard. I'm faster now.

entries.name: Wen Zhao
entries.title: Rival
lines: The tournament finals. You and me. Don't disappoint.
Talent is a door. You still have to walk through it.

entries.name: Vendor He
entries.title: Fair vendor
lines: Candied hawthorn! Sect badges! Lucky charms!
Buy a lucky charm. Can't hurt.

entries.name: Rui
entries.title: Retired disciple
lines: I washed out at Heart Tempering. The Heart Trial shows you things.
Pick the sect whose method suits your breath, not your pride.

entries.name: Elder Gao
entries.title: Greyreed Hamlet
lines: The grey came up from the pools. It took the colour, then the people.
If the well runs clean again, we might come home.

entries.name: Trader Min
entries.title: Greyreed trade post
lines: Greyreed trades again! Thanks to you.

entries.name: Hermit Yao
entries.title: Marsh hermit
lines: The otters trust me. Maybe one day they'll trust you.
Spirit beasts are not tools. They are friends who bite.

entries.name: Steward Wei
entries.title: Jade Sect steward
lines: Service disciples sweep, carry and learn. In that order.
Your bunk is in the dorm. Keep it tidy.

entries.name: Master Kong
entries.title: Weapon master
lines: Try each weapon. Your hands will choose before your head does.
A weapon is only your arm, longer.

entries.name: Deacon Rui
entries.title: Mission deacon
lines: Missions earn contribution. Contribution earns everything else.
Five missions a day. The board refreshes at dawn.

entries.name: Master Lin
entries.title: Training hall master
lines: A technique is a question your meridians learn to answer.
Practice twenty times. Then twenty more.

entries.name: Librarian Zhu
entries.title: Librarian
lines: Methods by rank. Manuals by contribution. Silence by law.
Torn pages can be restored. Torn students less so.

entries.name: Smith Ouyang
entries.title: Sect smith
lines: The sect forge answers to disciples with Qi in their hands.
Common first. Earth when you've earned it.

entries.name: Elder Bian
entries.title: Formation elder
lines: Lines on the floor, fuel in the nodes, intent in the centre.
A good formation outlives its maker.

entries.name: Physician Nan
entries.title: Sect physician
lines: Injured disciples, bitter medicine.
A needle in the right place is worth a hundred pills.

entries.name: Gardener Ji
entries.title: Sect gardener
lines: Plant, water, wait. Harvest.
Willow moss likes shade and gossip.

entries.name: Disciple Hao
entries.title: Outer disciple
lines: The Heart Trial? Don't talk about the Heart Trial.
I heard the elders fought a Hollow thing last winter.

entries.name: Steward Ruo
entries.title: Cloud Sect steward
lines: Service disciples sweep, carry and learn. In that order.
Your bunk is in the dorm. Keep it tidy.

entries.name: Master Fei
entries.title: Weapon master
lines: Try each weapon. Your hands will choose before your head does.
A weapon is only your arm, longer.

entries.name: Deacon Heng
entries.title: Mission deacon
lines: Missions earn contribution. Contribution earns everything else.
Five missions a day. The board refreshes at dawn.

entries.name: Master Qiao
entries.title: Training hall master
lines: A technique is a question your meridians learn to answer.
Practice twenty times. Then twenty more.

entries.name: Librarian Pei
entries.title: Librarian
lines: Methods by rank. Manuals by contribution. Silence by law.
Torn pages can be restored. Torn students less so.

entries.name: Smith Tan
entries.title: Sect smith
lines: The sect forge answers to disciples with Qi in their hands.
Common first. Earth when you've earned it.

entries.name: Elder Lou
entries.title: Formation elder
lines: Lines on the floor, fuel in the nodes, intent in the centre.
A good formation outlives its maker.

entries.name: Physician Qu
entries.title: Sect physician
lines: Injured disciples, bitter medicine.
A needle in the right place is worth a hundred pills.

entries.name: Gardener Ren
entries.title: Sect gardener
lines: Plant, water, wait. Harvest.
Willow moss likes shade and gossip.

entries.name: Disciple Ling
entries.title: Outer disciple
lines: The Heart Trial? Don't talk about the Heart Trial.
I heard the elders fought a Hollow thing last winter.

entries.name: Disciple Yue
entries.title: Inner disciple
lines: Inner disciples get the good retreat rooms.
Qi Unfurling feels like breathing with your whole skin.

entries.name: Elder Hu
entries.title: Jade Sect elder
lines: The river does not hurry, yet it carves the valley.
Come to me when you hit a wall. Walls are my speciality.

entries.name: Elder Sung
entries.title: Cloud Sect elder
lines: The wind does not fight the mountain. It goes over.
Bring me your walls. I'll show you the sky above them.

entries.name: Arena Master Quan
entries.title: Arena
lines: Three wins for the qualifier. No excuses.
The Valley Tournament crowns one champion a year.

entries.name: Warden Cao
entries.title: Nine Peaks toll warden
lines: Every sky road in the Expanse belongs to the Nine Peaks Alliance.
Toll first, questions after. The Factor's hall is in the market.

entries.name: Alliance Guard
entries.title: Nine Peaks patrol
lines: Keep your Qi to yourself inside the port.
Nine peaks, one law. The Alliance's.

entries.name: Jiang
entries.title: Independent cultivator
lines: The Alliance calls us 'unaffiliated'. We call ourselves free.
Valley folk come through that gate every few years. Most go home.

entries.name: Factor Ruan
entries.title: Alliance factor
lines: Stormsteel, stormsilk, fair Alliance prices.
Spirit Stones only. Taels are for the valley.

entries.name: Peddler Gou
entries.title: Sky road peddler
lines: Pills, charms, rice balls. Everything a traveller forgets.
I've walked every sky road twice. Once to go, once to come back for my hat.

entries.name: Smith Hong
entries.title: Stormsteel smith
lines: Stormsteel wants a Sage's hands. Before that, it bites.
Lightning Scar ore, spark pelt for the grip. That's the recipe.

entries.name: Apothecary Wu
entries.title: Port apothecary
lines: Storm blood is real. Newcomers bleed Qi into the wind until they attune.
A Storm Blood Pill buys you half an hour of patience.

entries.name: Sailor Pei
entries.title: Sky-ship hand
lines: Never look down from a sky-ship. Look at the sails.
The Alliance ships run to Nine Peaks. When they feel like it.

entries.name: Sailor Ning
entries.title: Sky-ship hand
lines: The Qi cushion under the keel? Twelve stones a day to keep it fed.
Storms on the plains sink ships. We go round.

entries.name: Dockmaster Fu
entries.title: Skydock master
lines: No berths for private ships without Alliance papers.
The Condensing Hall? Behind me. Mind the alchemist; she bites harder than the smith.

entries.name: Innkeeper Tang
entries.title: Wayfarers' Inn
lines: Rooms by the night, soup by the bowl, gossip for free.
The broker in the corner? Pays her bill. That's all I ask.

entries.name: Broker Mu
entries.title: Free broker
lines: I sell what the Alliance doesn't want sold. Mostly, the truth.
Your blood is still valley-soft. The storms here will drink it.

entries.name: Alchemist Fen
entries.title: Condensing Hall
lines: Sage Qi is True Qi pressed until it remembers it was once light.
Bring me thunder and I'll condense it into something you can swallow.

entries.name: Old Suo
entries.title: Thunderhorn herder
lines: The thunderhorns aren't cruel. They're just very sure of where they're going.
Stew's hot. Stones, not taels, I'm afraid.

entries.name: A-Lan
entries.title: Herder's daughter
lines: Spark weasels steal the lightning out of the grass. Then they spit it at you!
Grandpa Suo says the storms remember everyone who crosses.

entries.name: Hermit Shuang
entries.title: Rimefrost hermit
lines: Snow keeps every footprint until the wind decides otherwise.
Silence is not empty. Listen.

entries.name: The Grey Pilgrim
entries.title: A stranger
lines: You carry the valley's river on you. How quaint.
Every shard finds its way home in the end. I only help them along.

entries.name: Envoy Lanshi
entries.title: Alliance envoy
lines: Nine peaks, nine seats, one voice. Mine, today.
The Alliance keeps the sky roads open. Someone has to.

entries.name: Elder Zhong
entries.title: First Peak elder
lines: The First Peak remembers when there was no Alliance. There were more graves then.
A Hollow shard in the wrong hands is a war waiting for a reason.

entries.name: Auctioneer Tong
entries.title: Auction Pavilion
lines: Lots at dawn, hammers at dusk. Bid with your head, pay with your stones.
The limit is in the other bidder's heart. Find it.

entries.name: Champion Qiao
entries.title: Presence Terrace
lines: Presence is the weight a cultivator puts on the air. Show me yours.
Nine peaks, nine styles. I've learned eight.

entries.name: Tollkeeper Bai
entries.title: Canyon Mouth toll
lines: Ten stones a crossing. Alliance tokens pass free.
Brigands in the canyon wear veils. Honest folk don't.

entries.name: Warden Tie Shan
entries.title: Ironroot gatekeeper
lines: The Ironroot don't bend. We grow around things.
Outsiders come to the Hold for iron. Few come for kin.

entries.name: Matriarch Tie Yun
entries.title: Ironroot matriarch
lines: Blood is who you were born to. Roots are who you choose to hold.
Our ancestors sit in the Hall. They're picky about company.

entries.name: Smith Gang
entries.title: Ironroot forge
lines: Iron from the roots, fire from the canyon wind. Best forge in the Expanse.
Kin get the good steel. Guests get the rest.

entries.name: Keeper Meng
entries.title: Oasis of Bones
lines: Water is free. Shade is free. Everything else costs stones, because the caravans stopped coming.
Drink before the heat asks you to. By then it's late.

entries.name: Bone-Reader Xiu
entries.title: Diviner of the oasis
lines: The bones remember the sand kings. I only read them aloud.
Every crack in a shoulder blade is a road. Most end in the tomb.

entries.name: Lan Yue
entries.title: Healer
lines: Stay close. I can't heal what I can't reach.

entries.name: Tie Niu
entries.title: Brawler
lines: Hit me. No, harder. See? Iron Ox.

entries.name: Qiu Feng
entries.title: Archer
lines: I mark them. You hit them. Simple.

entries.name: Bai Ling
entries.title: Formation student
lines: Three nodes and a centre. Watch.
